facts.detail: The Demilitarized Zone spans 250 kilometers across the Korean Peninsula.
Virtually no travel has been permitted across the Korean buffer zone since 1953.
Armenia and Turkey share a 330-kilometer international border.
The land border between Turkey and Armenia has been fully closed since 1993.
Morocco and Algeria share a border measuring roughly 1,600 kilometers.
The Moroccan-Algerian frontier was locked in 1994, forcing detours through third nations.
India and Pakistan keep most of their shared line heavily barricaded.
The Attari-Wagah post is the primary active land crossing between India and Pakistan.
Bhutan and China do not maintain formal diplomatic relations.
No official land border entry points exist between Bhutan and China.
